    <div class="course-flow" aria-label="Pedagogical cycle of a module">

      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">2</span><h3>Adventure</h3><p>Work in class through a guided situation: role, data, code, interpretation and decisions to explain.</p></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">3</span><h3>Challenge</h3><p>Extend the adventure in the same universe with more autonomy and an assessed deliverable.</p></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">4</span><h3>Exercises</h3><p>Consolidate technical skills in other contexts. Exercises are separate from the challenge narrative.</p></article>
    </div>

      <article class="phase-card"><span>Modules 7-8</span><h3>Act responsibly</h3><p>Responsible visualization, ethics, anonymization and careful automation.</p></article>
      <article class="phase-card"><span>Modules 9-10</span><h3>Share with judgment</h3><p>Prediction, bias, text, dashboarding and communication of results.</p></article>
